commit.message:
Add Complete DigitalOcean Cloud Deployment Infrastructure

Production-Ready Cloud Deployment Features:
- Comprehensive Kubernetes deployment (deploy/digitalocean.yml)
  * Namespace isolation with production labels
  * ConfigMaps and Secrets for secure configuration
  * HorizontalPodAutoscaler for automatic scaling (3-10 replicas)
  * LoadBalancer with health checks and external access
  * PersistentVolumeClaim for data storage (100GB)
  * NetworkPolicy for security and traffic control

- Automated deployment script (deploy-to-digitalocean.sh)
  * Automatic doctl and kubectl installation
  * DigitalOcean authentication and cluster creation
  * Container registry setup and image pushing
  * Complete end-to-end deployment automation
  * Service discovery and external IP configuration

- Terraform infrastructure as code (terraform/main.tf)
  * VPC and networking configuration
  * Kubernetes cluster with autoscaling node pools
  * Container registry and load balancer setup
  * Firewall rules and security groups
  * Redis database for production UTXO storage
  * Spaces bucket for backups and disaster recovery

- Comprehensive deployment guide (DEPLOYMENT.md)
  * Quick start and manual deployment options
  * Infrastructure components and cost estimates (~77/month)
  * Security best practices and monitoring setup
  * Troubleshooting guide and production checklist

Cloud Infrastructure Ready:
✅ Kubernetes cluster with autoscaling (3-10 nodes)
✅ Load balancer with health checks
✅ Container registry for Docker images
✅ Redis database for production UTXO storage
✅ Automated SSL/TLS and networking
✅ Monitoring and observability endpoints
✅ Backup and disaster recovery setup

METAMORPH NOW READY FOR PRODUCTION CLOUD DEPLOYMENT!
